units.source_text: 良平在二十六岁的那一年，带着妻子儿女一起来到东京生活。

en.t: In the year when Ryohei was twenty-six, he moved to Tokyo to live there with his wife and children.

units.source_text: 如今，他在一个杂志社的二楼，手里握着红笔做着校对稿件的工作。

en.t: Now he works on the second floor of a magazine company, holding a red pen as he proofreads manuscripts.

units.source_text: 可是，不知为何，良平时常会想起自己小时候的那件事情。

en.t: Yet for some reason, Ryohei often remembers that incident from his childhood.
Does he truly not know why?

units.source_text: ——俗世的生活让良平身心俱疲，他眼前常常浮现出一条路，就像小时候的那条路一样，路上竹林昏暗微明，坡道高低起伏，细细长长，断断续续。

en.t: Worldly life has worn Ryohei out in body and mind, and a road often appears before his eyes, just like the road from his childhood: dimly lit bamboo woods, an uneven slope, long and narrow, continuing in broken stretches.
